messages.body_plain:
Technically, I'm on sabbatical this spring.  In practice, I'm not going anyplace farther than downstairs to my office until the vaccine gets around to me.

I want to take a break from running the R group for this semester, but I'm willing to continue participating if somebody else takes over the scheduling &c.

Any volunteers?

    --Russell

messages.body_plain:
Announcement:
Mariola Moeyaert, Ph.D (Associate professor of Statistics, University at Albany) designed a sequence of four hands-on R Studio workshops for those who are looking to use R for applied statistical tasks. Topics include ?Data Visualizations using ggplot2?, ?basic/intermediate statistical inferential tests? (t-tests, correlation, simple and multiple regression, ANOVA), and ?advanced statistical inferential tests? (ANCOVA, MANCOVA, logistic regression, HLM, meta-analysis, SEM, propensity score analysis, social network analysis). All four workshops will be organized on Fridays in February and the first week of March (11AM-3PM, EST). More details (full description of the four workshops) and registration can be found here: https://www.statisticalsolutionsinc.com/post/new-sequence-of-four-r-workshops<https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/www.statisticalsolutionsinc.com/post/new-sequence-of-four-r-workshops__;!!BCR0FSePrR4x!XdwYNETiGrc3u8UIhfflfGOYEoEhdKSvO6cD5Flxod1ordurouJeROOzYjyBtpVV$>
